events.title: HELLO HACKER 2 is in Steam Next Fest — play the demo
events.summary: We're in Steam Next Fest! 🟢 HELLO HACKER 2: Project Daybreak is taking part in Steam Next Fest this October, and the free demo is available right now. events.summary: The Official Trailer is here Two minutes, and for the first time it explains what this is actually about. The SQL injection at 1:22 is the actual foothold in the Prologue — you find the legacy login yourself, you read the page source, you spot the unsanitised query, and you write the payload. Whether you found us through Hello Hacker or stumbled on the store page, I appreciate you being here this early. I want to use these updates to be straight with you about what the game is, how it's being built, and what the road to launch actually looks like.
